title: Mere baba
body:
mere baba mai karun kya
khaak par neend nahi aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad aata hai mujhe reh reh kar
aap ka seena tha mera bistar
aaj ye waqt pada hai baba
khaak bistar hai andhera chadar
din tadap kar mai guzarun
raat matam mein guzar jaati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun faryad sunega meri
saath hai mere meri tanhaai
kaan zakhmi hai jigar zakhmi hai
khoon kano se abhi jaari hai
koi marham na dawa hai
maut nazdeek hui jaati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ko jaake dar e zindan par
roz mai dekhti hoo ye manzar
laut ke jaaye parinde jab ghar
dil mera rota hai bas ye keh kar
jaane kab mai jaaungi ghar
kab rehaai ki khabar aati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye wo shaam e ghariban baba
bhool sakti hi nahi ye dukhiya
aag qaimon mein lagi jab baba
jal gaya aag se daaman mera
keh rahi thi mai ye khud se
tu yateemi ki saza paati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
neel dekho mere rukhsaron ke
ye tamachon ke nishan hai gehre
mai jo roti hoo tumhare gham mein
maarta hai mujhe zaalim aa ke
jism qaidi rooh qaidi
ye aseeri mujhe tadpaati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan de dungi yahin ro ro kar
maut jeene se yahan hai behtar
aap talqeen padhana meri
ek ehsaan ye karna mujh par
chain se mai mar sakungi
ek yehi aas nazar aati hai
mere baba mai karun...
<<DIVIDER>>
bayn jo mazhar o mesum ne padhe
thay yehi bali sakina ne kahe
saath gar aap hamare hote
hai yaqeen thaam ke dil ro dete
kya jahan mein koi ummat
yun yateemon pe sitam dhaati hai
mere baba mai karun...
author: Mazhar Abidi
